role: Observed confocal-volume reconstruction of one human fallopian-tube organoid local infection response; no whole-PID mechanism

primary.rights: CC BY 4.0; no excluded Supplementary Movie 1 credit found

movie.operations: Lossless native-YUV re-encode, complete original frame order/field; all 749 decoded RGB frame hashes equal under FFmpeg7.1.1; no crop, interpolation, grading or local overlay

specimen: Human fallopian-tube epithelial organoid from surgical samples used by authors as anatomically normal tubes; benign gynecological procedures. Individual movie donor age, clinical history and fertility outcome unassigned.
representation: Source-produced Volocity6.3 volume reconstruction of confocal stacks. Green host GFP membrane reporter; red mCherry Chlamydia signal. Rendered perspective/grid retained; grid units unverified, no metric calibration.
time: Methods approximately30 planes every10min over approximately50h; Results24–72h after infection. Publication749 frames are NOT assigned one-to-one to acquisition stacks. Publisher-file seconds only, no fitted experiment clock.
claim_limits: Authors interpret inclusion/infected-cell expulsion and bursting; sampled stills do not establish a precise crossing/rupture path.
No whole-tract ascent, immune recruitment, scarring, occlusion, clinical infertility, treatment or inevitable progression.
Changing rendered viewpoint contributes apparent movement; no measured path, distance, pressure or flow.

print.layout: Two by two complete source stills, each78mm wide; external keys9.5pt, credits9pt; actual physical visibility pending

reproduction.public_immutable_inputs: Whole MOV, lossless WebM, exact PNG stills, all-frame RGB/PTS proof and this JSON; no private/network needed for composition
reproduction.source_acquisition: Original MOV separately acquired from official PMC OA index; primary XML and supplement description private research proof
reproduction.local_storage: WebM hard-linked to owned private derivative to avoid duplicate disk allocation; public input is a complete file, not a symlink/private runtime dependency
reproduction.large_file_limit: Exact 226769048-byte lossless WebM is stored as a checksum-pinned GitHub release asset and restored into the Pages artifact at the same URL; no recompression. See ../publication-media.json and ../tools/prepare_pages.py.
